missing_features.description: Migrate existing employee records and leave balances into the new System to ensure availability from day one.
missing_features.name: Data Migration
missing_features.reason: TOR requires complete employee records and leave balances to be available from the first day of live operation (ST-a9f40f94ca, page 3), but no data migration feature is in the backlog.

notes: User administration, role-based access, audit trail, and notifications are covered in the backlog as required by the TOR.
The backlog includes integration with attendance devices and payroll system as specified in the TOR.
Reports and dashboards cover the management and HR reporting needs as per TOR.
Employee documents upload and expiry tracking are implemented as required.
questions: What is the source system for existing employee records and leave balances for data migration?
What is the expected volume of historical data to be migrated?
Are there any specific data quality or cleansing requirements for the migration?
